overview: A futuristic AI cinematic studio dashboard with a 2035 neo-noir aesthetic, glassmorphism panels, and immersive creative OS interface for AI-powered movie production.
features: Floating frosted-glass sidebar navigation with holographic logo
Cinematic hero area with gradient headline and announcement pill
Glassmorphism AI prompt composer with model and workflow selectors
Generation mode tabs (Fast, Pro, Studio Max) with credit indicators
Cinematic preview showcase cards with hover play effects
Project gallery with thumbnails and public templates tab
Neo-noir visual design with electric blue and neon violet accents
Film grain overlay, bloom lighting, and smooth futuristic animations
